migration_chain.note: p7_s1_002 numbered < p7_s1_005 but chain correctly lists 002 as the descendant. M3 fix docstring explicitly preserves plan V2.2 names to avoid alembic rename risk; future plans should renumber.

util_results_indexes_orm_vs_migration.impact: SQLite pcs_test DB via Base.metadata.create_all will lack the composite (project_id, workspace_id) index. Production has it via migration, but the contract between ORM (DDL source-of-truth for tests) and migration (DDL source-of-truth for prod) diverges. Risk of test-vs-prod index divergence breaking query plans.
util_results_indexes_orm_vs_migration.fix: Add Index("ix_util_results_project_workspace", "project_id", "workspace_id") to UtilResults.__table_args__ (and optionally remove the redundant __table_args__ Index since the column already has index=True — but the migration explicitly names both, so keep both for parity).

util_results_inline_index_collision.detail: UtilResults declares both __table_args__=Index("ix_util_results_project", ...) AND column project_id with index=True (implicit). SQLAlchemy will emit a duplicate-index warning at create_all time. Migration op.create_index also creates the same index. Two paths to the same DB index is brittle.
util_results_inline_index_collision.fix: Pick one declaration site. Recommend keeping column-level index=True (matches workspaces_id pattern), and remove __table_args__ Index.

equipment_type_codes_seed_not_in_migrati.detail: S1-3 seed for equipment_type_codes lives in EquipmentTypeCodeService.seed_defaults (app/services/), NOT in alembic migration. Initial prod deploys table dd47298c9c38 created it empty; seed only fires when the service is invoked (no startup hook found in app lifespan).
equipment_type_codes_seed_not_in_migrati.impact: After migration upgrade, equipment_type_codes may be empty until the first API call that triggers seed. The composite FK on equipment_list.type_code→equipment_type_codes.type_code allows inserts without seeding; but seeding happens lazily and is NOT atomic with migration roll.
equipment_type_codes_seed_not_in_migrati.fix: Either (a) add a migration that does INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING for the 31 codes, or (b) wire EquipmentTypeCodeService.seed_defaults into FastAPI startup lifespan.

audit_logs_detail_json_gin_orm_match.detail: AuditLog ORM (app/models/system.py:122) declares detail_json as JSONB. Original table ddl in dd47298c9c38_v3_1_full_schema_53_tables_adr_0023.py also creates JSONB detail_json column. GIN index addition is purely additive — no column-type mismatch.

equipment_list_source_service_orm_match.detail: EquipmentList ORM (app/models/equipment.py) declares source_service as String(64), nullable=True, with identical comment. Migration matches exactly.

p7_s1_001_equipment_list_source_service.detail: add_column String(64) nullable=True — PG 11+ metadata-only (no table rewrite). Nullable avoids backfill requirement (per V1.4 design: source service = data migration concern, not infra change). Downgrade op.drop_column reverses cleanly. Historical rows have NULL which is semantically correct (legacy rows have no source service).
p7_s1_001_equipment_list_source_service.production_data_impact: Zero. Existing equipment_list rows receive NULL for new source_service column. Composite UNIQUE/project_id+tag_number NOT added (per D2 ruling and TaggedRecordMixin convention enforced at service level).

p7_s1_002_audit_logs_detail_json_gin.detail: CREATE INDEX ix_audit_logs_detail_json_gin on audit_logs (detail_json) USING gin with jsonb_path_ops. Does NOT use postgresql_concurrently=True. audit_logs is a hot, append-only audit table with active production INSERTs (audit_service.write() is called on every state change). Building a GIN index on a populated audit_logs table without CONCURRENTLY acquires a SHARE lock that blocks all DML for the duration of the build (seconds-to-minutes depending on row count and jsonb_path_ops generation). GIN build is CPU + I/O heavy; blocking window scales with table size.
p7_s1_002_audit_logs_detail_json_gin.production_impact: All audit logging (every state change, every login, every mutation that goes through audit_service) will queue behind the SHARE lock for the entire build. This will surface as: (1) HTTP request latency for any write path that touches audit_logs, (2) potential connection-pool exhaustion if backlog grows, (3) downstream events emitted by audit writes stall, (4) if pool is fixed-size, frontend write requests time out (504) during build window.
p7_s1_002_audit_logs_detail_json_gin.fix: Add postgresql_concurrently=True to op.create_index (requires if_not_exists=True or pre-check). This makes the build take an extra table scan + extra-row scan but releases the SHARE lock immediately and allows DML during build. Trade-off acceptable for a hot audit table. Alternative: run CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY manually in a pre-deploy step outside the migration.
p7_s1_002_audit_logs_detail_json_gin.jsonb_path_ops_choice: GOOD — supports containment @> only, index ~30% smaller than default GIN, matches documented R-03 T0 containment query pattern (WHERE detail_json @> '{"stale_resolution_path": ...}').

p7_s1_005_util_results_new_table.detail: CREATE TABLE util_results with PK util_result_id (UUID), FK projects, FK workspaces, business_date (Date, nullable), consumption_json (JSONB NOT NULL with comment '13 类 flat'), jsonb_deprecated (BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT false with explicit comment for Sprint 2 marker), source (VARCHAR(200) nullable), created_at (NOT NULL DEFAULT now()), updated_at (nullable). New table; no existing data to migrate. FK references existing projects/workspaces (created in dd47298c9c38). Downgrade reverses cleanly.
p7_s1_005_util_results_new_table.production_impact: Zero on existing tables. New empty table created; no backfill required (Sprint 1 JSONB authoritative; Sprint 2 will populate jsonb_deprecated=True after 5-table migration).
p7_s1_005_util_results_new_table.jsonb_deprecated_marker: GOOD — explicit bool column + server_default=false + comment makes Sprint 2 transition contractually clear. Server default ensures existing rows are JSONB-authoritative without manual UPDATE.
p7_s1_005_util_results_new_table.consumption_json_not_null: GOOD — non-null JSONB column means schema enforces 13-class payload; avoids nullable JSON trap.
p7_s1_005_util_results_new_table.concern: updated_at is nullable=True with NO server_default and NO onupdate trigger. TimestampMixin in app/models/mixins.py may set onupdate=func.now() at ORM level, but DB has no DEFAULT or trigger. After a row is INSERTed, updated_at stays NULL until ORM layer updates it. For pure-API writes through PUT/POST endpoints the ORM will set it; for raw SQL or bulk imports it will stay NULL. Document the contract or add DB-level trigger.

util_results_timestampmixin_mismatch.detail: Migration declares created_at NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at nullable WITHOUT default. UtilResults inherits TimestampMixin (per app/models/util.py docstring). Need to verify TimestampMixin in app/models/mixins.py matches (does it add onupdate=func.now() to updated_at?). If TimestampMixin sets onupdate=func.now() at ORM level, the ORM will populate updated_at on UPDATE statements — but DB-level there is no enforcement.
util_results_timestampmixin_mismatch.fix: Verify TimestampMixin matches the migration. If diverged, either align migration DDL or document that updated_at is ORM-managed (not DB-enforced).

downstream_impact: audit_service.write() queues — every state change, login, mutation
request latency spike on all write paths
audit_logs_gin_lock_window.recommendation: DO NOT deploy p7_s1_002 in production during peak hours. Either (a) modify migration to use postgresql_concurrently=True, or (b) execute CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ix_audit_logs_detail_json_gin ON audit_logs USING gin (detail_json jsonb_path_ops); manually before/after migration deploy. The migration downgrade op.drop_index is non-CONCURRENTLY (acceptable — drops are quick metadata ops).

equipment_list_source_service_add.detail: add_column nullable=True without DEFAULT — PG 11+ does metadata-only ALTER TABLE. No table rewrite, no row-level lock for long duration. Brief AccessExclusiveLock for catalog update.

util_results_create_table.detail: CREATE TABLE on empty table — minimal lock. FK validation fast (parent tables small). Indexes build on empty table — instant.

p7_s1_001_downgrade.detail: alembic downgrade -1 drops source_service column. Since no backfill happened, no data loss. op.drop_column is fast (metadata-only).

p7_s1_002_downgrade.detail: alembic downgrade -1 drops ix_audit_logs_detail_json_gin. op.drop_index is non-CONCURRENTLY (acceptable — DROP INDEX acquires ACCESS EXCLUSIVE for microseconds on a built index). No data loss (index is auxiliary).

p7_s1_005_downgrade.detail: alembic downgrade -1 drops all 3 indexes then drops util_results table. Reverses cleanly. CAVEAT — if production has already inserted data into util_results between upgrade and downgrade, that data is lost. Verify empty table before downgrade.

blocking_issues.title: audit_logs GIN index build without CONCURRENTLY will block all audit writes
blocking_issues.recommendation: Add postgresql_concurrently=True and if_not_exists=True to op.create_index, OR execute CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY manually in pre-deploy. Without this, every audit_logs INSERT during build will queue and likely cause user-visible 504s.

blocking_issues.title: UtilResults ORM missing composite (project_id, workspace_id) index declaration — schema drift vs migration
blocking_issues.recommendation: Add Index("ix_util_results_project_workspace", "project_id", "workspace_id") to __table_args__ so SQLite test DB (via create_all) matches prod DDL.

blocking_issues.title: EquipmentTypeCodes seed (31 codes) is service-level, not migration-rolled — not atomic with schema deploy
blocking_issues.recommendation: Add a migration that does INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING for the 31 codes, OR wire EquipmentTypeCodeService.seed_defaults into FastAPI lifespan startup.

informational_observations.title: Migration chain numbering intentionally out-of-order (p7_s1_002 chains AFTER p7_s1_005)
informational_observations.detail: M3 fix docstring preserves plan V2.2 filenames. Chain is valid and linear; just unusual numbering. Future plans should renumber.

informational_observations.title: util_results updated_at column has no DB-level DEFAULT or trigger
informational_observations.detail: ORM-managed only. For raw SQL writes updated_at will stay NULL. Document contract or add trigger.

informational_observations.title: equipment_list source_service column added nullable without DEFAULT
informational_observations.detail: On PG 11+ this is metadata-only (fast). Confirm production PG version >= 11; if older, table rewrite would be required.

approval_recommendation.rationale: CRITICAL DM-P7S1-001 (audit_logs GIN without CONCURRENTLY) requires fix; HIGH DM-P7S1-002 (util_results schema drift) requires alignment. After both fixes, MEDIUM DM-P7S1-003 (seed atomicity) should be addressed but is not strictly deploy-blocking.

summary.migration_correctness_overall: 1 critical (lock window), 1 high (schema drift), rest safe
